Both traces share the same fixed attribute pairings and converge on the identical final arrangement. Trace 1 branches first on Elm’s year (1714/1716/1715), while Trace 2 branches first on Cloth’s year (1711/1713) and then on the year in slot 1. In Trace 1 the Elm=1714 and Elm=1715 branches are pruned, leaving Elm=1716; Trace 2 independently prunes Elm=1715 and confirms Elm=1716 is viable, so those divergences are grounded and paid off. Trace 1’s productive Birch=1714 subbranch and Trace 2’s productive Slot1=1714 branch both yield the same configuration. Both traces also repeat verification/rechecking after the solution is found.
